Richard Wagner - Der Ring Des Nibelungen [Rare UK stereo 19LP Box Set] (1968) Hi-Res



WAGNER Der Ring Des Nibelungen (Rare 1968 UK stereo 19-LP box set on the blue Decca narrow band label, performed by Birgit Nilsson, Kirsten Flagstad, Wolfgang Windgassen, Hans Hotter and Christa Ludwig with the Vienna State Opera Chorus and Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Sir Georg Solti. Recorded between 1959 and 1966, this epic production is arguably the definitive performance of the Ring cycle on vinyl and is in great demand. Each opera is housed in its own individual box with libretto booklet and all are contained in a handsome picture slipcase. There is some scuffing to the outer case, with light wear to the individual boxes and the vinyl is Excellent with very little sign of play.
